name: DWI Info
summary: Reports basic information about a DWI dataset (image header, b-values/shells and b-vector checks) with DIPY dipy_info 1.1.1, as text files.
description: Runs dipy_info three times: on the DWI image, on the bvecs (checking unit norm within bvecs_tol) and on the bvals (counting b0 volumes below b0_threshold and grouping shells within bshell_thr). Use it as a quick sanity check of DWI data before processing; it does not modify the data.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with its bvals and bvecs.

outputs.description: Text reports dwi_info.txt, bvecs_info.txt and bvals_info.txt.

parameters.description: Threshold used to check that norm(bvec) = 1 +/- bvecs_tol b-vectors are unit vectors (default 0.01).
b-value at or below which a volume is treated as b0 when summarising the bvals.
The threshold for distinguishing b-values in different shells (default 100).

citations.text: Garyfallidis E et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Frontiers in Neuroinformatics 8:8 (2014).
